# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait top-down elemental quest RPG titled Four Nations: Balance Quest. Preserve the original mechanics exactly: drag anywhere on the canvas to move the hero toward the pointer, automatically attack with a fast orbiting weapon, spawn enemies from screen edges, apply radial collision damage, allow shooter projectiles, drop timed loot with damage/speed/defense/heal upgrades, score kills, level up every 10 kills, spawn a boss after 30 kills, win when the boss is defeated, lose when HP reaches zero, and restart from modal buttons.

Transform the presentation into an Avatar-inspired elemental spirit-road adventure: the hero is a young Avatar, the orbiting weapon is air-wheel bending, enemies are corrupted spirits, loot is elemental scrolls and spirit tea, score is Harmony, HP is Spirit Balance, levels are Pilgrimage stages, and the boss is an Unbalanced Spirit Titan redeemed through combat. Use a procedural animated background with air/water/earth/fire motifs, readable mobile HUD, touch-friendly CTAs, warm found-family copy, and catalog-approved fantasy/UI fonts and nature-adventure audio.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: mobile portrait top-down action RPG / survival arena
- objective: drag the hero around the arena, survive incoming enemies, defeat enemies with an automatic orbiting weapon, collect upgrade loot, trigger a boss after 30 kills, and defeat the boss for victory
- input model: pointer/touch drag on the canvas only; UI buttons use native click/tap
- core loop: start run → move toward drag target → enemies spawn at edges and pursue or shoot → orbiting weapon damages enemies → killed enemies award score and may drop loot → every 10 kills raises level → 30 kills spawns boss → win or lose → restart
- fail/friction state: HP drains on enemy/boss/projectile contact; game over hides HUD and shows restart

## Protected Mechanics
- Drag-to-move control target and speed model.
- Canvas update/render loop with edge spawning and radial collision checks.
- Orbiting automatic attack radius/timing and damage upgrades.
- Enemy families: basic chaser, erratic fast enemy, tank enemy, shooter projectile enemy.
- Score, kill count, level-up every 10 kills, boss spawn at 30 kills, victory by boss HP reaching zero.
- Loot drop chance, timed loot life, and upgrade semantics for damage, speed, defense, and healing.

## Remix Blueprint
The rebuilt game is Four Nations: Balance Quest, a mechanically faithful elemental quest RPG. The green hero becomes a young Avatar traveling a spirit road with a found-family mission. Monsters become corrupted spirits that are calmed by an orbiting air-wheel bending form. Loot becomes elemental scrolls: air increases strike strength, water improves movement, earth improves defense, and spirit tea heals balance. Score becomes Harmony, HP becomes Spirit Balance, levels become Pilgrimage stages, and the boss is an Unbalanced Spirit Titan redeemed at the end. Presentation, copy, palettes, silhouettes, background motifs, and HUD language are transformed while controls, collisions, score/progression, win/loss, and restart semantics remain unchanged.
